# focus.sh

> Terminal-first focus & task manager in Go — ADHD-friendly attention management and a fast TUI.

## What it is
A Go CLI/TUI for focus and task management: rituals, attention management, and lightweight local automation in a fast terminal dashboard.

## Install / use
Build from source with Go (`go build ./...`) or grab a release binary.

## Links
- Repository: https://github.com/simongonzalezdc/focus.sh
